paraphrase: Argues every side-effecting tool call should be a two-stage protocol: accepted, then independently observed. Command issuance is not completion (SpaceX analogy). Proposes: idempotency key, record expected postcondition, poll/subscribe to an independent state signal, only then commit success; on observation timeout preserve the receipt and report unresolved state.

claims.text: Every side-effecting tool call should be a two-stage protocol: accepted, then independently observed
Command issuance is not completion: issue with an idempotency key, record the expected postcondition, poll or subscribe to an independent state signal, only then commit success
claims.notes: On timeout preserve the receipt and report unresolved state
